name: Verified Transform Example Corpus
description: Engine-verified, ODIN-native (odin->odin) transform examples. Each fixture is rendered into the published transform Cookbook. Every expectedOutput is the exact engine-produced ODIN; the golden runner proves it.

header.note: The standard odin->odin header ({$} + {$source} format=odin + {$target} format=odin) is prepended to each fixture's transform by the runner and generator; fixtures store only the mapping block(s).

idiomGroups.name: Format conversion
idiomGroups.description: ODIN is the canonical model; odin<->json, odin<->xml, odin<->csv, and odin<->fixed-width are all common paths. Seeded: odin->xml. Placeholders remain for the others.
